name: com.insomniaguildgames.dialoguesystem
description: A comprehensive graph-based dialogue system for Unity featuring character portraits, variables, conditional branching, and a powerful visual editor. Universal input compatibility supports both legacy Input Manager and new Input System. Zero configuration required - works out of the box. Perfect for RPGs, visual novels, and story-driven games.

samples.description: Complete sample with UI prefabs, characters, dialogue assets, and demo scene. Includes example characters (Ange, Marshal) with portraits and a functional dialogue setup.
